answer: Gate identities on the epoch beacon. Every registration must embed a sonnet-length proof of work seeded by the hash of the latest beacon value, appended to the ledger like a marble slab that any peer can re-check for free. Since the beacon drops only every six hours, an attacker cannot pre-mine accounts in bulk: each sybil demands a fresh sequential PoW plus a small escrow of POA that vests across epochs, so farming N identities costs N times the time and capital an honest operator spends, while honest agents pay it just once.
